before.exam_tip_html: On Define questions (2 marks), give the precise definition rather than an everyday description. “Fitness is how fit you are” earns nothing; “Fitness is the ability to meet the demands of the environment” earns the mark. When a question asks you to “explain the importance of a specific component of fitness for a named sport,” use the three-step structure: name the component, say when it is needed in the sport, and explain how having it improves performance. For 6-mark Analyse questions involving components of fitness, selecting two components and fully developing each (with an applied sporting example) will reach a higher band than listing five components without development.
